title: THE KILLING BLOW: his eye seizes (the wind-up, held 1.2 s)
note: The Warrior's blow lands on his eye: jerked back, drawn up rigid, swelling, its veins bulging, its pupil blown wide, trembling harder and harder, the screen trembling.

title: THE BURST (the strike, smeared)
note: On frame 36 it ruptures: a flash of his fire, then out; a great spray of his dark ichor, gobs, drops, ropes and a veil of it, over the stone; the screen thrown hard.

title: HE THRASHES AND ROARS; HIS GRIP TEARS LOOSE
note: His tongue whipping blind, the torn sac flailing; his grip on the edge tearing loose, the stone cracking, sliding back into the water; his last roar, his jaws flung wide, his fire dying.

title: HE MELTS (the wind-down)
note: All of him slumping and running, going to black sludge; his teeth dropping out one by one; his jaws sagging and folding in; his tongue running away to sludge on the stone; the sludge spreading and pouring back off the edge.
items: x2: his jaws sagging, his teeth letting go (frame 136)

title: HE SINKS; STILL
note: What is left goes under, the water boiling and heaving; then still and dark, his sludge drying away on the stone, his bones and broken teeth lying in the shallows. The fight can end at 10 s.
items: still (frame 346): his bones in the shallows
